# Tanvo Tech

> Tanvo Tech is a premier digital engineering agency specializing in high-performance full-stack web platforms, mobile applications, custom AI agent integrations, and business process automation.

## Core Capabilities & Services

- **Web Development**: Modular, scalable web applications and SaaS platforms built using the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js) and Next.js. Sub-second first-paint performance, resilient REST/GraphQL APIs, and enterprise cloud deployments.
- **Mobile App Development**: Cross-platform iOS and Android mobile applications built with React Native and Flutter. Features offline-first architecture, SQLite synchronization, hardware sensor telemetry, and smooth 60fps animations.
- **AI Solutions & LLM Integrations**: Production-grade AI systems, custom conversational agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines over private documentation, vector database search (Pinecone/Chroma), and automated tier-1 triage agents with strict enterprise data privacy (zero data retention).
- **Digital Process Automation**: Custom webhook chains, automated ETL pipelines, CRM integrations (Salesforce, HubSpot, Zendesk), and event-driven worker queues (BullMQ, Redis).
- **All-in-One Cloud & Support**: Zero-downtime AWS / Vercel cloud migrations, Docker container orchestration, cybersecurity audits, database performance tuning, and 24/7 SLA maintenance.

## Engineering Stack & Standards

- **Frontend**: React 19, Next.js (App Router), Tailwind CSS, TypeScript, Three.js, Lucide Icons, Vite.
- **Backend & APIs**: Node.js, Express, Python (FastAPI / LangChain), REST, WebSockets, Webhooks.
- **Databases & Cache**: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Pinecone, ChromaDB, SQLite.
- **DevOps & Cloud**: Docker, AWS (ECS, S3, RDS), Vercel, Cloudflare, GitHub Actions CI/CD.

## Key Performance & Delivery Metrics

- **Zero Downtime Migration**: Migrated production ERP with 40k daily transactions to AWS with 0 minutes downtime.
- **Lighthouse Performance**: 100/100 Lighthouse score with Largest Contentful Paint under 0.9s.
- **AI Support Efficiency**: 73% of customer tier-1 tickets auto-resolved via custom semantic AI triage.
- **Delivery Velocity**: Average MVP ship time between 2 to 6 weeks with a 24-project consecutive on-time delivery streak.

## Engagement & Business Model

- **Sprint-Based Delivery**: Bi-weekly agile engineering sprints with dedicated client portal tracking, live staging URLs, and asynchronous video demos.
- **Full IP Ownership**: 100% transfer of source code copyright, Figma design systems, and cloud infrastructure keys upon milestone settlement.
- **Dual-Currency Billing**: Supports Indian Rupee (INR with 18% GST) and International Currencies (USD, EUR, AED with 0% Export LUT).
